cases.name: All internal roles lose the seven modules and both empty navigation groups
Retired workers do not process historical jobs or send scheduled reports
Dealer Portal keeps its search, notifications and period-sales modules
Desktop and mobile omit removed navigation, header links and dashboard task panels
Direct, create, detail and hub URLs return 404 to the administrator
Removed read, write, task dependency and download APIs all return 404
Orders, stock, finance, documents, audit and profile remain accessible
Partner details and quick-create no longer offer tasks or general export
Warehouse, accountant and factory routes cannot restore removed features
Dealer Portal pages and shared APIs remain available
